name: Solstice-Arid

civilization.name: The Solstice Wanderers
civilization.notes: A nomadic civilization that follows the seasonal habitable zone, building temporary cities at each solstice point before migrating. They have developed sophisticated solar-powered technology.

description: Solstice-Arid is a large desert world with a pronounced axial tilt that shifts the habitable temperature zone dramatically between hemispheres with each season. The rocky plateaus and sandstone formations bake under relentless sun during summer and cool to comfortable temperatures only when the solstice brings the season's turn.

The breathable atmosphere carries the dry heat of sun-baked stone and the faint mineral scent of ancient sandstone. Oases fed by deep aquifers sustain pockets of green in the canyon systems, their waters precious and carefully managed by the civilization that calls this world home.

The Solstice Wanderers have built their entire culture around the seasonal migration, constructing temporary cities at each solstice point using prefabricated solar-powered modules. Their subterranean water pipelines span the planet, ensuring each new settlement has access to the deep aquifer network they have engineered over centuries.

The Wanderers are aware of interstellar civilization and cautiously engage in trade, primarily exchanging their advanced solar technology for materials they cannot manufacture. Their mobile society presents unique diplomatic challenges, as authority shifts between city-builders at each solstice, and agreements must be renewed with each migration cycle.
